we have developed a novel algorithm, LFSPRO, to predict the probability of TP53 mutations in LFS families, and we have evaluated its performance in three different datasets.

LFSPRO is the best tool to predict TP53 mutation carrier probability and future cancer risk for LFS families and individuals, and can be used to support clinical decision-making for TP53 testing and LFS clinical management.
LFSPRO has been shown to be more sensitive, specific, and accurate than the Chompret criteria and the classic LFS criteria.
